justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Non-inferior to in-person cardiac/pulmonary rehab in multiple RCTs. Adherence rates comparable when tech support provided.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Online modules plus supervised hours; moderate time investment; growing provider availability.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable specifically to cardiac and pulmonary rehab delivery via telehealth; limited outside these programs.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Cardiac and pulmonary rehab CPT codes applicable via telehealth; CMS telehealth expansion supports billing; commercial coverage broad.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing demand in cardiac and pulmonary rehab programs with telehealth delivery models.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Convenience strongly preferred by patients with transportation barriers; technology literacy barrier for some older adults.
justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Remote cardiac/pulmonary monitoring vendors (BioIntelliSense, Cleerly, Recora) hire clinicians for program design.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Steady demand driven by Medicare RPM/RTM reimbursement expansion.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Modest premium for niche clinical expertise on RPM teams.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Combines clinical protocol design with wearable/RPM integration knowledge.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Clear pathway into virtual cardiac/pulmonary rehab companies.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Moderate-cost training with reasonable career payoff.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Remote cardiopulm coaching has real cash-pay potential for tech-comfortable post-cardiac patients and concierge models.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Still uncommon among rehab clinicians; reasonable differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Telehealth platforms scale exceptionally well across trained staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Growing post-COVID acceptance but cardiopulm-specific consumer demand is modest.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Telehealth competency increasingly valued but no single credential is canonical.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active and growing literature, especially post-2020.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Relevant to telehealth/digital health threads being added to DPT/MOT curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence base is moderate and still maturing.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally listed as a 'preferred' competency, rarely required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Low cost/time; reasonable academic ROI for emerging-area credibility.
